message.content: {"caption":"Three side-by-side line charts compare Base, PPO, and GRPO results across three Qwen-2.5 model sizes.","description":"The target is a set of three line charts with circular markers. All use model size on the x-axis, with categories Qwen-2.5-3B, Qwen-2.5-7B, and Qwen-2.5-14B, and a legend identifying Base (blue), PPO (orange), and GRPO (green). The left chart reports F1 Score, with labeled y-axis ticks from 20 to 45; Base rises substantially, while PPO and GRPO rise gradually and finish close together. The middle chart reports B1 Score, with labeled ticks from 15 to 40; all series rise, and PPO and GRPO end well above Base. The right chart reports J Score, with labeled ticks from 40 to 70; Base rises from 3B to 7B then falls at 14B, while PPO and GRPO rise throughout. At 3B and 7B, GRPO is highest in each chart; at 14B, PPO is slightly highest for B1 and J, and PPO and GRPO are nearly tied for F1. Values below are estimated from plotted marks; no individual data values are
